visualRisks.description: Waterfront district has a large, unbroken area of 'rr' characters in the top rows which might appear as an endless road or water body, causing confusion.
visualRisks.suggestion: Consider breaking up the large areas with other elements like houses or docks.

visualRisks.description: The route path crosses over itself (e.g., from 42 to 76 and back to 93), which could create a navigation loop.
visualRisks.suggestion: Review the route for any loops that might confuse players.

navigationRisks.description: The route path includes a large jump from position 103 to 115, which could be disorienting.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Smooth out the jumps in the route for better player experience.

navigationRisks.description: There are no clear visual indicators (like lighthouses or houses) guiding players along the route, making navigation challenging.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Add more landmarks to help guide players through the district.
